description: This file defines the RouteCollector class in the FastRoute namespace, responsible for collecting and managing route definitions, including adding routes for various HTTP methods and grouping routes with prefixes.

classes.name: RouteCollector
classes.description: Class for collecting and managing HTTP route definitions, supporting route grouping and method-specific route addition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RouteCollector with a RouteParser and DataGenerator.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a route for specified HTTP methods, with support for route grouping via prefix.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a route group with a common prefix, executing a callback within the group context.
